description: A common locally invasive skin cancer arising from basal cells of the epidermis.
causes: Accumulated DNA damage, commonly related to ultraviolet exposure

appearance.general: A slowly growing skin-coloured, pink, or pigmented nodule or plaque; nodular lesions may appear shiny or pearly and can bleed or ulcerate.

warning_signs: A persistent, enlarging, bleeding, or ulcerated lesion should be assessed by a clinician.
prevention: Use protective clothing and sun protection.
doctor_discussion_points: Discuss lesion duration, change, bleeding, and cumulative sun exposure.
